GRITTY.Module.Title: Gritty Realism Rests
GRITTY.Rest.Label: Take Rest
GRITTY.Rest.Tooltip: Take Rest — 8 hours. Resources return on their own schedule.
GRITTY.Summary.Title: Rest Completed
GRITTY.Panel.Title: Gritty Realism
GRITTY.HitDice.Title: Hit Dice
GRITTY.HitDice.Label: Hit Die ({denomination})
GRITTY.Ledger.Title: Recovery Ledger — {name}
GRITTY.Ledger.ResetConfirm: Reset all Gritty Realism state for {name}? Every pending recovery and debt entry is discarded.
GRITTY.Party.Title: Party Rest
GRITTY.Party.Hint: Select the actors who will rest. Each keeps its own ledger.
GRITTY.Warning.NativeRestBlocked: Short and Long Rest are disabled. Use Take Rest instead.
GRITTY.Warning.NoPermission: You do not have permission to rest this actor.
GRITTY.Warning.PlayerRestDisabled: Only the GM can start a rest in this world.
GRITTY.Warning.NoActiveGM: No GM is connected, so the rest cannot be recorded.
GRITTY.Warning.RestVariant: The dnd5e "Rest Variant" setting is not set to Normal. Gritty Realism Rests controls rest pacing itself, and the system's gritty variant multiplies daily recharge formulas by 7. Set Rest Variant to Normal to avoid double-counting.
GRITTY.Warning.RestFallback: This dnd5e build does not expose the internal rest routine. Falling back to applying recoveries directly; rest chat cards will still be created.
GRITTY.Warning.InProgress: A rest is already in progress for this actor.
GRITTY.Warning.NotResponding: The GM client did not respond. The rest was not recorded.
GRITTY.Settings.ShortRestCount.Name: Short Rest cooldown
GRITTY.Settings.ShortRestCount.Hint: Number of Rests before a short-rest resource returns.
GRITTY.Settings.LongRestCount.Name: Long Rest cooldown
GRITTY.Settings.LongRestCount.Hint: Number of Rests before a long-rest resource returns.
GRITTY.Settings.DailyRestCount.Name: Daily cooldown
GRITTY.Settings.DailyRestCount.Hint: Number of Rests before a resource that recharges at dawn, dusk or per day returns.
GRITTY.Settings.HitDiceRestCount.Name: Hit Dice cooldown
GRITTY.Settings.HitDiceRestCount.Hint: Number of Rests before a spent hit die returns. Each die is tracked independently.
GRITTY.Settings.HpMode.Name: Hit point mode
GRITTY.Settings.HpMode.Hint: How hit points recover between rests.
GRITTY.Settings.HpMode.Debt: Recovery Debt — damage becomes debt paid off by healing or by time
GRITTY.Settings.HpMode.Gritty: Gritty Standard — full healing only on the long-rest schedule
GRITTY.Settings.RestDuration.Name: Rest duration (minutes)
GRITTY.Settings.RestDuration.Hint: In-world duration of one Rest. Used when advancing the game clock.
GRITTY.Settings.AllowPlayerRest.Name: Players may take rests
GRITTY.Settings.AllowPlayerRest.Hint: When disabled, only a GM can start a rest.
GRITTY.Settings.HudIntegration.Name: Token Action HUD integration
GRITTY.Settings.HudIntegration.Hint: Add Take Rest to the HUD and suppress its native rest actions.
GRITTY.Settings.ChatSummary.Name: Rest summary in chat
GRITTY.Settings.ChatSummary.Hint: Post a chat card after each rest listing what recovered and what is still pending.
GRITTY.Settings.ExhaustionDelta.Name: Exhaustion change per rest
GRITTY.Settings.ExhaustionDelta.Hint: Applied on every Rest. Use -1 to mirror the long-rest behaviour, or 0 to leave exhaustion alone.
GRITTY.Settings.TrackManualEdits.Name: Track manual expenditures
GRITTY.Settings.TrackManualEdits.Hint: Record resources spent by clicking sheet pips or editing values directly, not just via activities.
GRITTY.Settings.TrackGmDirectEdits.Name: Track expenditures made by a GM
GRITTY.Settings.TrackGmDirectEdits.Hint: On by default. Turn it off only if GM edits to sheets are usually corrections rather than play — with it off, a GM who also plays a character loses those expenditures silently. Activity usage and hit dice are always tracked either way.
GRITTY.Settings.LogLevel.Name: Log level
GRITTY.Override.Title: Gritty Realism Recovery
GRITTY.Config.Title: Gritty Realism Rests
GRITTY.Config.MenuHint: Cooldowns, hit point handling, tracking and integrations.
GRITTY.Config.Group.Cooldowns.Label: Cooldowns
GRITTY.Config.Group.Cooldowns.Hint: How many Rests each kind of resource takes to return. One Rest is eight hours.
GRITTY.Config.Group.HitPoints.Label: Hit Points
GRITTY.Config.Group.Rest.Label: The Rest
GRITTY.Config.Group.Rest.Hint: What taking a rest does, and who may take one.
GRITTY.Config.Group.Tracking.Label: Tracking
GRITTY.Config.Group.Tracking.Hint: Which expenditures the ledger records. Activity and Midi-QOL usage is always tracked; these govern everything else.
GRITTY.Config.Group.Integration.Label: Integration
GRITTY.Config.Group.Integration.Hint: How the module appears on sheets and in the Token Action HUD.
GRITTY.Config.Group.Advanced.Label: Advanced
GRITTY.Settings.DebtOrder.Name: Healing order
GRITTY.Settings.DebtOrder.Hint: Which wound healing closes first. Oldest first drains debt steadily, so it rarely matures on its own. Newest first leaves old wounds ageing, and only time clears them.
GRITTY.Settings.HideShortRest.Name: Remove the Short Rest button
GRITTY.Settings.HideShortRest.Hint: Hides Short Rest on the sheet and in the HUD, and blocks the underlying system flow. Turn this off to keep short rests working as normal alongside Take Rest.
GRITTY.Settings.HideLongRest.Name: Remove the Long Rest button
GRITTY.Settings.HideLongRest.Hint: Hides Long Rest on the sheet and in the HUD, and blocks the underlying system flow. Turn this off to keep long rests working as normal alongside Take Rest.
GRITTY.Settings.SheetPlacement.Name: Sheet placement
GRITTY.Settings.SheetPlacement.Hint: Where the recovery display appears on the character sheet.
GRITTY.Rest.Quality.Title: How did the night go?
GRITTY.Rest.Quality.full.Label: Slept well
GRITTY.Rest.Quality.poor.Label: Slept badly
GRITTY.Entry.AddTooltip: Add a cooldown by hand — a lingering wound, a curse, a favour owed
GRITTY.Entry.Name: Name
GRITTY.Entry.DescriptionPlaceholder: Disadvantage on Strength checks until it heals.
GRITTY.Entry.TypeHint: Decides whether a badly slept night still counts towards it.
GRITTY.Entry.ConsumeHint: Also marks the use as spent on the sheet, so it matches the ledger.
GRITTY.Settings.ContextMenu.Name: Right-click menu on items
GRITTY.Settings.ContextMenu.Hint: Adds "Put on cooldown" to the context menu of items on a sheet.
GRITTY.Settings.PoorRestShort.Name: A poor rest still credits short-rest cooldowns
GRITTY.Settings.PoorRestLong.Name: A poor rest still credits long-rest cooldowns
GRITTY.Settings.PoorRestLong.Hint: Off by default. This is what makes a badly slept night matter.
GRITTY.Settings.PoorRestDay.Name: A poor rest still credits daily cooldowns
GRITTY.Settings.PoorRestHitDice.Name: A poor rest still credits hit dice
GRITTY.Config.Group.RestQuality.Label: A Poor Night
GRITTY.Config.Group.RestQuality.Hint: Every rest can be taken as slept well or slept badly. A poor night still passes time, but only credits the cooldowns ticked here — hit point debt follows the long-rest setting.
GRITTY.Panel.ManualOnly: Does not recover on its own — hand it back from here or from the ledger.
GRITTY.Config.Group.AutoRecovery.Label: Automatic Recovery
GRITTY.Config.Group.AutoRecovery.Hint: Whether each kind of cooldown clears on its own when its time is up. Switched off, the expenditure still counts down, settles at 0 and stays in the list until somebody hands it back deliberately.
GRITTY.Settings.AutoRecoverShort.Name: Short-rest resources recover automatically
GRITTY.Settings.AutoRecoverLong.Name: Long-rest resources recover automatically
GRITTY.Settings.AutoRecoverDay.Name: Daily resources recover automatically
GRITTY.Settings.AutoRecoverHitDice.Name: Hit dice recover automatically
GRITTY.Settings.AutoRecoverDamage.Name: Damage taken heals automatically
GRITTY.Settings.AutoRecoverDamage.Hint: Off means wounds never close on their own: the debt settles at 0 and only healing, or the GM, clears it.
GRITTY.Period.Label: Long rest period
GRITTY.Period.Hint: Nothing returns until the period closes. {count} rests to go.
GRITTY.Period.Closing: This rest completes the long rest — everything below comes back.
GRITTY.Period.Stalled: held at {count} — a poor night does not count towards the long rest
GRITTY.Config.Group.Model.Label: Recovery Model
GRITTY.Config.Group.Model.Hint: How recovery is paced. Everything below applies to whichever model is selected here.
GRITTY.Config.Group.Period.Label: Long Rest Period
GRITTY.Config.Group.Period.Hint: Only used by the long rest period model. A poor night never counts towards the period, following the same switch the other model uses.
GRITTY.Settings.RecoveryModel.Name: Recovery model
GRITTY.Settings.RecoveryModel.Hint: Per-expenditure cooldowns, or a rolling long rest that returns everything at once.
GRITTY.Settings.RecoveryModel.Ledger: Per-expenditure cooldowns — each thing spent runs its own clock
GRITTY.Settings.RecoveryModel.Period: Long rest period — nothing returns until the period closes, then all of it does
GRITTY.Settings.PeriodLength.Name: Rests per long rest
GRITTY.Settings.PeriodLength.Hint: How many Rests complete one long rest period.
GRITTY.Settings.PeriodRecoversShort.Name: A closing period returns short-rest resources
GRITTY.Settings.PeriodRecoversLong.Name: A closing period returns long-rest resources
GRITTY.Settings.PeriodRecoversDay.Name: A closing period returns daily resources
GRITTY.Settings.PeriodRecoversHitDice.Na: A closing period returns hit dice
GRITTY.Settings.PeriodRecoversDamage.Nam: A closing period heals damage taken
GRITTY.Settings.PeriodRecoversDamage.Hin: Clears every outstanding wound and refills hit points.
